title: Smallest K-Length Subsequence With Occurrences of a Letter
goal: Find the lexicographically smallest length-k subsequence containing enough copies of a required letter.
strategy: Use a monotonic stack, but pop only if enough total characters and required letters remain to finish. Reserve available slots for still-needed required letters before accepting other characters.
